arguments.value: Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS system boots from a cloned SATA SSD after moving from a SATA HDD, but there is a 20–30 second pause early in boot despite updating fstab and swap resume UUIDs. The delay disappears when the old HDD is attached, suggesting boot is waiting on something related to the previous drive/UUIDs.
